title: Go to declaration of a JDK class

intellij.action: Ctrl+B on String in the main signature
intellij.notes: opens String.java from the JDK sources, or the decompiled class when there is no src.zip; the tab name is recalled

knownGap: jdtls resolves the declaration but the IDE opens only files of the project; classes of libraries and the JDK are not opened
